title: Build a first coding project
summary: A guided mini-project pathway for a student who wants evidence of coding ability rather than another certificate.
eligibility: Any learner with access to a browser.
checklist: 1) Choose a problem; 2) build one small feature; 3) publish the code; 4) write what you tested and changed.

title: Prepare for a peer-tutoring session
summary: Use a structured preparation sheet before meeting a tutor so the session begins with a specific question.
eligibility: Learners who can use English-language peer tutoring.
checklist: 1) Write the exact topic; 2) attempt one question; 3) mark where you got stuck; 4) bring that evidence to the session.

title: Create an international-exam study sprint
summary: A two-week plan that turns an exam target into daily practice, error review and one checkpoint.
eligibility: Students preparing for an international exam.
checklist: 1) Choose one section; 2) take a short diagnostic; 3) log errors; 4) repeat the weak skill; 5) retest after 7 days.

title: Start an application evidence portfolio
summary: Collect projects, research, volunteering and measurable outcomes in one structured evidence file before writing essays.
checklist: 1) Create evidence categories; 2) add links/files; 3) record your personal role; 4) record one learning point; 5) update monthly.

title: Low-bandwidth learning pack
summary: A workflow for learners with unreliable internet: prioritize downloadable text, screenshots, PDFs and short sessions over video-heavy study.
eligibility: Learners with limited connectivity or device access.
checklist: 1) Choose one weekly topic; 2) download text/PDF material when connected; 3) study offline; 4) save questions; 5) sync progress later.
